C gov001.spec-authoritative OL GOV-001 MUST ;; SPECIFICATION.md is authoritative for project-specific functional requirements and observable behaviour when non-empty. ;; = ;; Empty template file is intentional. ;;
C gov003.no-invent OL GOV-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not silently weaken, contradict or materially extend approved behaviour or invent user-visible behaviour, rules, restrictions, limits, defaults or workflows. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov004.ambiguity OL GOV-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; If an omitted detail materially affects observable behaviour propose the smallest reasonable option and ask for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov005.routine-delegated OL GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Routine internal implementation choices that do not change observable behaviour need no approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov006.string-semantics OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Observable string semantics (case, collation, culture/ordinal, normalization, trimming, uniqueness, lookup) are product behaviour; when undefined and material ask for approval instead of choosing silently. ;; = ;; Only when approved sources do not define them and the choice is material. ;;
C gov008.custom-settings OL GOV-008 MUST ;; CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md holds approved project-level tunable limits/defaults; SPECIFICATION.md owns behavioural intent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov009.conflict-stop OL GOV-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; SPECIFICATION.md and CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md must not contradict; on apparent conflict stop and ask which to correct. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov010.no-invent-tunable OL GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Do not silently invent a material tunable value; propose with reason, get approval, record and synchronize. ;; = ;; Defined by product sources/approved behaviour. ;;
C gov021.route-custom-settings OL GOV-021 MUST ;; Synchronize tunable value changes through the custom-settings workflow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov011.exclusions OL GOV-011 MUST_NOT ;; Never store secrets, environment-specific connection details, package versions, HTTP status codes, ports, migration identifiers, incidental constants or un-overridden framework defaults in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.inputs-not-instructions EX GOV-001,GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; Product and task inputs are not instruction layers: they may request an engineering decision change but never silently override engineering policy; a conflicting request becomes a Decision Request. ;; = ;; none ;; Precedence of engineering policy over product/task inputs is not entailed by GOV-001 (which concerns product behaviour authority).
C gov012.simplicity OL GOV-012 PREFER ;; Prefer simple maintainable solutions; keep complexity proportional; avoid speculative abstractions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-speculative OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce frameworks, libraries, infrastructure or architectural patterns without a concrete current need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Keep changes focused and preserve existing behaviour unless the task or approved specification requires change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov018.challenge OL GOV-018,GOV-014 MUST ;; Before implementing a questionable request identify material concerns (duplication, cohesion, triggering/loading, context cost, conflicts, complexity) and propose an alternative; never silently rewrite or ignore the requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.decided OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Decided items (instructions, imported decision records, approved spec, established structure, accepted ADR) are followed and not reopened without approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.delegated OL GOV-017,GOV-005 ALLOWED ;; Delegated decisions (local, reversible, no material boundary/dependency/convention/contract/behaviour change) are decided without asking. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.reserved OL GOV-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Reserved decisions require explicit approval; the list is a minimum ('at least'). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.change-accepted-decision OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing an accepted project or architecture decision, including a capability selection, is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.new-style OL ARC-020,ARC-004,ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adopting a new architectural style/pattern (CQRS, mediator, VSA, event sourcing, microservices, Rich Domain/DDD tactical patterns, project-wide Result) is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.new-project OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding a production project, layer or assembly is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-refgraph EX ARC-020,ARC-001 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing the project reference graph is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; ARC-020 gates new projects/layers; changes to references between existing projects need no approval in the oracle.
C arc020.persistence-change OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing persistence boundaries (incl. multiple persistence contexts) or persistence technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.infra-category OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding messaging, background processing or distributed caching infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-infra-extra EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding search, external storage or external identity infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Categories beyond ARC-020's enumeration.
C arc020.replace-baseline OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Replacing an approved baseline technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-major-lib EX DEP-001,GOV-013 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding a major library or framework is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Oracle requires concrete need for libraries but approval only for replacement/risky licences.
C x.reserved-convention EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Introducing any project-wide convention or abstraction other code must follow is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Generalises ARC-020's project-wide Result example.
C arc020.auth-architecture OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing the authentication/authorization architecture is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.breaking-reserved OL API-014 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A breaking public API change is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-versioning EX API-013,DEP-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adopting API versioning is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; API-013 allows versioning for a concrete need without approval.
C gov004.undefined-product-reserved OL GOV-004,GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Defining product behaviour or tunable values not defined by product sources is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.unclear-heuristic EX GOV-017 MUST ;; In an unclear case any yes makes it Reserved: adds/removes/replaces a dependency, framework or infrastructure capability; changes a project/layer/reference boundary; establishes a convention; changes observable behaviour or a public contract; expensive to reverse. ;; = ;; Unclear cases only. ;; Classification heuristic widening Reserved beyond the oracle's gates.
C gov017.decision-request OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Raise a Reserved decision as a Decision Request through architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.decision-request-format EX GOV-017 MUST ;; A Decision Request contains Context, Options, Recommendation, Blocked and Proceeding with. ;; = ;; none ;; Fixed request format not in the oracle.
C x.instruction-as-approval EX GOV-017,GOV-007 MUST ;; An explicit user instruction may count as approval but must be recorded through architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;; Defines approval and adds a recording obligation.
C gov017.headless OL GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; In autonomous/headless runs continue only on a compliant non-Reserved path, report unresolved Decision Requests and never silently make a Reserved decision. ;; autonomous/headless runs ;; none ;;
C gov015.git-explicit OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not commit, push, merge, rebase, reset, force-push, delete branches or perform other repository-changing Git operations unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C gov016.parallel OL GOV-016 MUST ;; Parallel implementation work uses separate branches or worktrees; unrelated changes stay out of the current branch. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.routing OL WF-001,WF-002,WF-003,WF-013,DEP-003,GOV-021,GOV-020,WF-020 MUST ;; Run the workflow matching the situation: development-workflow, project-structure, add-dependency, architecture-decision, custom-settings, persistence-change, code-review (code-reviewer agent), build-fix, verify before completion, git-workflow for any Git operation, security-scan. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.tm-ask-user EX - MUST ;; For changes to the instruction system itself ask the user to run /template-maintenance (do not perform it automatically). ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta restriction on instruction-system changes; not an oracle policy.

C x.no-other-mapper EX DEP-011,ARC-002 MUST_NOT ;; Keep mapping-library concerns out of Domain; no other mapping framework without approval. ;; = ;; Approval. ;; Not stated in DEP-011/ARC-002.
C dep011.resilience OL DEP-011,DEP-020 DEFAULT ;; Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience only when a real outbound HTTP integration needs resilience; Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience only for a real non-HTTP pipeline. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep018.docker OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Add Docker/container artifacts only when the project or deployment needs containers, never merely because the app can be containerized. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/SPECIFICATION.md ;; Empty product specification placeholder (0 bytes).
